regime_context: Hong Kong thematic landscape is narrow and bifurcated: Banks (H + HK) lead decisively on absolute trend-gate eligibility and top rank, while Diversified Miners is the only challenger above 1.0 score but fails the eligibility gate. Only 4 of 17 themes are eligible, confirming a concentrated, defensive-financials regime rather than a broad rally. The track record (18/19 hits) is strong but small-sample; all calls remain low conviction by default.
emerging_watch: China Platform Megacaps (hk_platform_tech) — rank 15, score -1.035, breadth 0.0, mean-revert-ish — I am watching for its score to rise above -0.3 while breadth exceeds 0.4, which would suggest a leadership handoff attempt from defensive financials toward China tech; until that combination appears, the watch stays as a non-call.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the rotation board with the highest score, pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate, have the strongest durability bar (0.67) and the broadest internal breadth (0.769) among eligible themes, suggesting the leadership is cohesive rather than a single-name spike. Crowding is moderate (z=0.79, not flagged), so this is a trend-continuation lean, not a fade forecast. This is expressed purely as a directional preference grounded in the gate-helping regime; the detector's cross-sectional rank is a focus lens, not an alpha claim.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.417, the only theme above 1.1
durability_bar 0.67, the highest among eligible themes
breadth 0.769 — widest participation of any eligible theme
crowding_z 0.79 below the crowded threshold, so no cap warning
theses.dissent: Banks are a classic late-cycle defensive rotation; if the macro backdrop (unscheduled-share 1.0) turns pro-growth or AI/tech re-accelerates, leadership may stall or reverse without the detector's coincident indicators warning in advance.

theses.subject: Diversified Miners
theses.thesis: Despite the second-highest momentum score (1.033) and a trend hurst tag, Diversified Miners fails the absolute-trend eligibility gate, which per the backtest is the only validated risk-control leg. The gate_helps=true means skipping ineligible themes historically avoided drawdowns on this market. Approaching an ineligible theme with no ETF proxy also means it is unscorable and cannot be graded. Leaning to avoid expresses the discipline, not a return forecast.
evidence: durability_bar 0.27, low relative to gate threshold
theses.dissent: A strong commodity cycle can lift miners sharply even when the trend metrics are weak; the absolute-trend gate controls risk but sacrifices upside in the theme's strongest impulse moves.

falsifier.text: Diversified Miners flips to eligible=true and its breadth rises above 0.3 within 20 days

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the only other eligible theme in the top four with a solid durability bar (0.65) and acceptable breadth (0.625), making it a defensive complement to the Banks leadership. It sits in the Telecom/Utilities/Income category, which typically correlates with the defensive-financials regime currently dominating. The call is a directional preference on the same trend-gate logic, not a belief that it will outperform Banks in rank.
theses.dissent: If the underlying regime shifts toward growth/cyclicals (miners, tech), dividend blue chips lag badly even while remaining eligible on the trend gate, creating a prolonged underperformance scenario.
